jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

The organization is seeking a hands-on, multi-disciplinary Chief Technology Officer to lead its end-to-end technology organization, spanning product engineering, IT infrastructure, and corporate and platform cybersecurity.

Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer and partnering with executive leadership, this executive provides comprehensive oversight across technology, enterprise systems, and risk management. The Chief Product, Engineering, and Data Officer reports directly to this role.

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States.

Key Responsibilities

Drive overall technology strategy, cloud infrastructure, and technical execution for the organization's core SaaS platform.
Manage the enterprise technology budget and drive cost optimization across software licensing, infrastructure procurement, hardware lifecycles, and vendor contracts.
Partner with executive leadership to transition new products from beta to market launch while actively managing technical debt.
Advise the CEO and Board of Directors on enterprise technical risk, disaster recovery, business continuity planning, and corporate cyber resilience.
Oversee day-to-day corporate IT operations, including endpoint management, automated provisioning and deprovisioning, and multi-tier helpdesk support.
Administer enterprise productivity suites and communication architectures while enforcing zero-trust access controls, single sign-on (SSO), and document retention policies.
Oversee business system infrastructure in close alignment with organizational leadership to ensure high uptime and integration security.
Direct organization-wide information security initiatives across corporate endpoints, networks, and SaaS tools.
Establish and audit enterprise IT policies, including acceptable use, zero-trust identity and access management (IAM), data loss prevention (DLP), and offboarding protocols.
Enforce compliance and audit readiness—including SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, ISO 27001, and c3/c4 non-profit legal boundaries—in collaboration with Legal, HR, and Finance.
Evaluate alpha projects and proofs of concept across departments, guiding execution to integrate them into the core SaaS platform or architect them as standalone, scalable services.
Mitigate vendor lock-in risk by establishing standardized data portability and integration frameworks across corporate SaaS applications.
Serve as direct manager to the Chief Product, Engineering, and Data Officer (CPEDO), establishing shared goals and aligning product, engineering, and data strategies with enterprise infrastructure and security standards.
Partner with the CPEDO on budget, resourcing, and prioritization trade-offs across product, engineering, and data initiatives.
Build, mentor, and scale a service-oriented IT and security team aligned with organizational growth objectives.
Establish pragmatic automated internal processes that maintain rigorous security standards without introducing operational friction for staff.

Qualifications

12+ years of progressive IT leadership experience, including roles such as Director of IT, Head of IT/Operations Technology, VP of IT, or Chief Technology Officer.
Demonstrated experience managing enterprise IT and information security stacks, zero-trust architectures, IAM, and automated endpoint management.
Experience driving capital and operational expenditure (CapEx/OpEx) strategies for corporate IT, including SaaS license management, hardware procurement cycles, and third-party vendor governance.
Proven track record leading enterprise security operations and successfully navigating SOC 2 Type II or ISO 27001 audit cycles.
Expertise in architecting, securing, and administering enterprise collaboration platforms and workplace productivity suites.
Proven track record of building and leading technical teams across a broad range of expertise.
Experience building or scaling an internal IT function through periods of organizational growth.
Demonstrated ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical staff, executive leadership, and Board members.

Compensation and Benefits

Annual salary: $220,000 to $230,000,
commensurate with experience.
Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
Healthcare Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings Account (HSA) options.
403(b) retirement plan with an employer match.
Paid vacation, paid holidays, and paid sick leave.
Paid parental leave.
Professional development and education reimbursement assistance.
Monthly technology and wellness stipend.

Additional Information

Essential duties reflect the primary functions assigned to this role and may be adjusted or reassigned at any time.
Employees must be able to perform the essential functions of the position satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations will be provided to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions, absent undue hardship.
The organization maintains a zero-tolerance policy regarding abuse and inappropriate behavior.

The organization is seeking an experienced technology operations leader with direct experience in data, data operations, hosting infrastructure, public and private cloud environments, development operations, and cybersecurity. This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the adoption and usage of advanced AI technologies across the operations organization to improve internal efficiency and accelerate product and business outcomes.
Track technology operational trends and AI advancements, identifying creative solutions to drive efficiency and greater throughput.
Provide leadership, vision, and strategy driving automation, stability, and availability of technology infrastructure leveraging cloud and on-premise technologies to support business agility.
Drive innovation across security, data privacy, data operations, development operations, and infrastructure.
Define the technology operations strategy and roadmap to support current and future business needs for scalability, capacity, and quality of service, including performance, reliability, and business continuity.
Define requirements for new technology implementations and communicate them to key business stakeholders.
Partner with senior leadership across the business to realize measurable outcomes aligned with business expectations.
Drive the execution of security, data, infrastructure, and technology operations initiatives to achieve targets for scalability, performance, and availability.
Assess and communicate risks associated with technology-related investments and purchases.
Support business growth initiatives by aligning technology operations with business strategy.
Develop business case justifications and cost-benefit analyses for technology operations spending and initiatives.
Implement the people, processes, and technologies necessary to meet customer demands.
Define, maintain, and present regular operational metrics to executive leadership, including overall security, data, and infrastructure health, risk areas, and productivity.
Define, measure, and improve technology standards across the organization to establish a technology-enabled competitive edge.
Provide technical assessments and due diligence for potential acquisitions.

Bachelor's degree or higher in computer science, information systems, or engineering.
15 years of experience managing technology operations across development operations, data, infrastructure, and cybersecurity.
Extensive knowledge and direct experience applying AI tools and methodologies to improve operational efficiency.

Experience with operational technologies for the deployment, maintenance, and monitoring of large-scale SaaS platforms.
Experience with hosting operations and leading cloud migrations involving AWS, Azure, and GCP.
Experience managing vendor relationships and negotiating contracts to optimize expense costs.
Strong executive communication skills with the ability to convey technical details and strategy to non-technical leadership.
Demonstrated success leading modernization and transformation initiatives across data and infrastructure environments.
Strong knowledge of cybersecurity methodologies and practices.
Demonstrated success leading large, diverse global teams and attracting and retaining talent.
Expert knowledge of technology environments, including networks, operating systems, databases, and application and web servers.
Technical experience in systems networking, databases, infrastructure, and user support.
Experience defining standardized operating procedures and services across operational disciplines.
Experience in strategic technology planning, execution, and policy development.
Experience with business processes, management, and budgeting.
Strong understanding of project management principles.
Proven experience in planning, organization, and development.
Demonstrated ability to apply technology solutions to business problems.
Experience with acquisition due diligence and integrations.

This leader will oversee IT operations, employee technology, enterprise business applications, integrations, workflow automation, and AI enablement for internal productivity and corporate operations. The role leads a multidisciplinary team responsible for delivering secure, reliable, and intuitive technology experiences across the organization.

The enterprise business applications portfolio includes internal systems supporting People, Finance, Accounting, Legal, Procurement, and Operations. This position requires a leader experienced in modernizing an IT or enterprise technology function through automation, intelligent self-service, AI agents, and integrated business systems, rather than focusing primarily on traditional infrastructure, administration, and ticket resolution.

Responsibilities

Define and execute the strategy and roadmap for corporate IT, integrations, automation, and AI, while establishing enterprise standards for business applications.
Deliver a secure, reliable, and frictionless employee technology experience while evolving IT operations from reactive support toward proactive, automated service delivery.
Partner with organizational leadership to enhance business processes, eliminate manual workflows, and identify high-value automation and AI opportunities.
Lead the evaluation, implementation, governance, and adoption of AI-enabled tools, agents, self-service capabilities, and workflow automation.
Ensure AI and automation solutions incorporate appropriate security, privacy, data access, human oversight, monitoring, and accountability.

Strong understanding of APIs, workflow orchestration, data flows, access controls, and application lifecycle management.
Experience partnering with Security to deploy and operate security technologies, manage access controls, conduct access reviews, support audits, and maintain secure onboarding and offboarding processes.
Experience managing IT and enterprise application budgets, vendors, contracts, licensing, service levels, and delivery partners.
Strong business judgment with the ability to communicate technology strategy, value, risks, and tradeoffs to executive leadership.
Demonstrated success leading organizational change and driving adoption of new tools and operating practices.

jobs.title: Director of Information Technology
jobs.description:
Role Overview

The Director of Information Technology
will oversee the internal technology estate end to end and lead the team responsible for running it. Reporting directly to the Chief Information Officer, this full-time role based in the United States covers identity, endpoints, networking, collaboration, service management, and the internal artificial intelligence platform across a distributed, remote-first organization.

This position is designed for a leader experienced in building and scaling internal technology through periods of rapid growth, possessing the capability to construct a multi-year roadmap while maintaining the ability to resolve operational issues directly. The role collaborates closely with Security, Engineering, Finance, and Human Resources leadership while managing vendor and managed service provider relationships.

Key Responsibilities

Build and execute a multi-year internal technology roadmap across identity, endpoints, networking, collaboration, and service management.
Tie technology investments directly to business outcomes with defined success measures.
Define internal delivery models versus services managed through partners and managed service providers.
Establish IT governance, operating standards, architecture reviews, and change management.
Design the internal IT function, build business cases for headcount, and hire and develop team members.
Mentor the team and establish clear ownership, on-call schedules, and escalation models.
Build and maintain the internal service catalog and associated service level agreements.
Own internal AI tool use case development, rollout, training, and adoption measurement.
Partner with the organization's AI practice so internal usage directly informs client-facing delivery.
Apply financial engineering to the internal AI estate by developing unit-cost models, forecasting consumption, negotiating commitments and reserved capacity, and holding AI expenditures accountable to measured productivity gains.
Own endpoint management, configuration baselines, patching, and hardware lifecycles using Intune or equivalent systems.
Manage the Microsoft 365 collaboration environment, including Teams, SharePoint, and Exchange governance.
Define and enforce device posture requirements for a remote-first workforce.
Direct internal network architecture, remote access, and secure connectivity models.
Manage the internal cloud and hosting footprint, including capacity, cost, and resilience.
Direct backup, recovery, and business continuity for internal systems with tested recovery objectives.
Establish and mature IT service management across intake, incident, problem, request, and change processes.
Publish operational metrics and systematically eliminate key sources of employee workflow friction.
Oversee the onboarding and offboarding technology experience in partnership with Human Resources.
Manage the internal IT budget, financial forecasts, and software licensing positions.
Rationalize the SaaS estate and direct renewals, contract negotiations, and vendor terms.
Hold external partners and managed service providers accountable to defined service levels.
Partner with security leadership to execute the IT components of the broader security program.
Support SOC 2 and ISO audit readiness, including control operation and evidence collection.
Own vulnerability management and remediation across internal systems and endpoints.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of information technology experience, including proven experience leading teams or owning a technology function.
Demonstrated experience building and scaling internal IT within a distributed or remote-first company during periods of rapid growth.
Experience presenting technology strategy, investment recommendations, operational risks, and performance metrics to executive leadership.
Deep hands-on experience with Microsoft 365, Entra ID, endpoint management (Intune or equivalent), and SaaS administration at scale.
Demonstrated ownership of internal AI adoption and governance, including policy creation, data handling, and change management.
Strong security fluency, with the ability to partner credibly with executive security leadership and translate technical risk into business terms.
Proven experience supporting SOC 2, ISO, or related regulated compliance and audit requirements.
Experience managing IT budgets and negotiating contracts with vendors and managed service providers.
Ability to communicate technical trade-offs clearly to both executive and technical audiences, in writing and in person.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience operating within a solutions provider, managed service provider (MSP), or technology consulting environment.
Relevant industry certifications, such as ITIL, Microsoft certifications, CISSP, CISM, PMP, or equivalent credentials.

Discretionary incentive compensation and bonus opportunities based on individual and organizational performance.
Comprehensive health coverage, including medical, dental, and vision insurance.
401(k) retirement plan with an employer match.
Flexible time off, paid holidays, and paid sick leave.

Life insurance.

jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

The hiring organization is seeking a strategic and hands-on Director, Infrastructure & IT Operations
to lead the technology capabilities that keep digital products, cloud platforms, and internal teams secure, reliable, and productive.

This role oversees cloud infrastructure, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), production operations, bot mitigation, corporate IT, and helpdesk support, while providing architectural leadership across cloud platforms, networking, identity, observability, and operational tooling. This position spans both internal employee technology and the production infrastructure supporting high-traffic, customer-facing applications.

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States.

Key Responsibilities

Lead teams responsible for cloud infrastructure, SRE, production operations, corporate IT, helpdesk, and bot mitigation, establishing ownership, operational standards, service-level objectives (SLOs), escalation procedures, and performance metrics.
Develop managers, technical leads, and IT staff through coaching, career development, and building a culture of accountability, documentation, automation, and continuous improvement.
Build quarterly and annual infrastructure roadmaps aligned with business priorities, growth, security, reliability, and cost, partnering with engineering, product, data, marketing, finance, HR, legal, and executive leadership.
Own the reliability, scalability, security, performance, and cost-effectiveness of cloud infrastructure, primarily within AWS.
Provide architectural leadership across cloud services, applications, APIs, networking, identity, databases, storage, observability, and integrations while establishing architecture standards, reference patterns, governance, and technical review processes.
Partner with engineering to improve deployment safety, performance, and readiness, driving automation, configuration management, and infrastructure as code.
Lead capacity planning for growth and demand spikes, eliminating single points of failure, undocumented systems, manual processes, and single-source dependencies.
Ensure production and nonproduction environments are properly separated, secured, and monitored, reviewing new systems for architectural fit, supportability, security, and total cost of ownership.
Establish and maintain service-level indicators (SLIs), SLOs, availability targets, and error-budget practices for critical systems.
Improve observability through centralized logging, metrics, distributed tracing, application performance monitoring (APM), and actionable alerting.
Lead major incident management, coordination, executive communication, root-cause analysis, and corrective-action tracking to improve mean time to detect, respond, and recover.
Develop and test backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity procedures, and establish sustainable on-call practices.
Own strategy and tooling for bot mitigation, scraping protection, automated abuse prevention, and traffic-quality management using technologies such as Cloudflare, DataDome, web application firewalls (WAFs), rate limiting, CAPTCHA alternatives, and device fingerprinting.
Partner with cross-functional teams to distinguish malicious automation from legitimate customers, search engines, partners, and approved AI crawlers, establishing monitoring and response procedures.
Oversee internal IT services and helpdesk support, establishing service-level expectations for response times, resolution times, user satisfaction, and backlog reduction.
Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, equipment provisioning, access management, asset recovery, and device inventory.
Standardize endpoint configuration, encryption, patching, and endpoint detection across laptops, collaboration platforms, productivity software, and telecom services.
Establish consistent identity and access management practices across corporate and production systems, implementing role-based access, least privilege, multi-factor authentication (MFA), periodic access reviews, and secure administrative account handling.
Support vulnerability remediation, security assessments, audits, vendor reviews, incident readiness, and applicable privacy requirements in partnership with legal and security teams.
Manage infrastructure, security, IT, telecom, monitoring, and support vendors, handling evaluations, contract reviews, renewals, licensing, service level agreements (SLAs), and budget management.
Improve cloud cost visibility through tagging, allocation, forecasting, tool consolidation, and contract optimization.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, SRE, platform engineering, DevOps, IT operations, or related disciplines.
5+ years of experience leading engineering or technology teams, including managing managers or technical leads.
Demonstrated experience operating high-traffic, customer-facing platforms in AWS or a comparable cloud environment.
Strong understanding of cloud architecture, networking, identity, security, observability, databases, APIs, storage, and distributed systems.
Experience managing production availability, incident response, root-cause analysis, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
Experience with infrastructure automation, configuration management, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code.
Experience managing corporate IT, employee support, endpoint management, software licensing, and access provisioning.
Experience establishing operational metrics, SLOs, and support standards.
Demonstrated ability to manage vendors, contracts, departmental budgets, and cloud costs.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical risks, architecture, and tradeoffs to executive audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Cloudflare, DataDome, or comparable bot-management and web application protection platforms, including leading bot mitigation or traffic-quality programs.
Experience with AWS services, containerized environments, infrastructure as code, centralized logging, and APM tools (such as AppDynamics).
Experience supporting large-scale consumer subscription, public-record, data-as-a-service, advertising, or ecommerce platforms.
Experience modernizing legacy infrastructure, transitioning systems from external vendors, and consolidating cloud accounts or IT services.
Familiarity with privacy requirements and secure handling of sensitive consumer data.
Experience building or maturing SRE, DevOps, or platform engineering functions.

Measures of Success

Improved availability, performance, and stability of customer-facing platforms.
Reduced impact and infrastructure costs associated with bots, scraping, and automated abuse.
Faster incident detection, response, and recovery, alongside a reduction in recurring incidents.
Enhanced observability with reduced alert noise, validated disaster recovery capabilities, and optimized cloud spend.
Consistent helpdesk performance, reliable onboarding and offboarding, and robust endpoint security and asset tracking.
Strong architecture governance, reduced dependency on undocumented systems or vendors, and demonstrated team development.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Cybersecurity (R6149)
jobs.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai . Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn , X , Instagram , and YouTube .

Job Description:

Lead the security strategy behind advanced, mission-critical technology. In this role, you’ll drive secure and scalable solutions, collaborate across technical and business teams, and help ensure complex systems are protected, compliant, and ready for real-world operations.

What you'll do:

Own the authorization portfolio

Hold overall accountability for RMF execution across all Shield AI classified systems under JSIG, DAAPM, and NIST SP 800-53, driving toward continuous authorization as the goal state.
Maintain a single authoritative view of authorization posture: ATO and IATT status, expiration dates, conditions, open POA&M items, and assessment findings across every system and site.
Own the accreditation roadmap and commit dates with program management, and manage the dependencies — facility, network, tooling, and personnel — that determine whether those dates hold.
Represent Shield AI as the senior security authority with Authorizing Officials, SCAs, government program security officers, and DCSA or cognizant SAPCO representatives.
Drive reciprocity and inheritance strategy so controls implemented once are reused across programs and sites instead of re-litigated in each package.
Approve risk acceptance recommendations, deviations, and mitigation strategies before they go to the government, and escalate residual risk to Shield AI leadership with a clear position.

Build the capability, not just the packages

Define the enterprise continuous monitoring strategy — vulnerability scanning, STIG and SRG compliance, audit review, and configuration drift detection — and hold the team to a reportable cadence.
Standardize package templates, control evidence libraries, hardening baselines, and inheritance documentation so new enclaves start from an accredited pattern.
Invest in automation — infrastructure as code, scripted STIG application, scan and evidence pipelines — to make compliance repeatable rather than heroic.
Select and own the security compliance toolchain (eMASS or Xacta, ACAS/Nessus, SCAP, SIEM) including budget, licensing, and government-directed tooling requirements.
Define metrics that reflect real security posture and report them to Federal Systems and company leadership.

Partner Across The Company

Work with IT, network, platform, and product security engineers so security architecture is designed in rather than retrofitted before an assessment.
Partner with Industrial Security, Facilities, and Contracts on new facility and enclave stand-ups from concept through ATO, including accredited network extensions between facilities.
Advise program managers and engineering leadership on accreditation timelines and the security consequences of architecture, schedule, and staffing decisions.
Own incident response leadership on classified systems: containment, spillage and contamination response, government reporting, and after-action corrective plans.
Ensure the classified user population is trained, access is least-privilege and auditable, and data transfer and media control actions follow program guidance.

Required qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical field
8+ years of experience in cybersecurity engineering, defense systems, mission systems, or military aerospace programs
Experience leading cybersecurity activities for complex integrated systems or defense platforms
Strong knowledge of RMF, STIGs, system hardening, network security, secure architectures, and vulnerability management processes
Experience working across hardware, software, networking, and mission system integration environments
Active Top Secret Clearance with SCI Eligibility

Preferred qualifications:

Experience supporting military aircraft, UAV, mission systems, or tactical communication platforms
Familiarity with resilient system architectures, zero trust principles, cross-domain solutions, and contested environment operations
Experience with MBSE methodologies and tools such as Cameo Systems Modeler
Background supporting cybersecurity test events, airworthiness, or platform accreditation activities

jobs.title: Vice President, Fund Finance Technology
jobs.description:
Over the last 20 years, Ares’ success has been driven by our people and our culture. Today, our team is guided by our core values – Collaborative, Responsible, Entrepreneurial, Self-Aware, Trustworthy – and our purpose to be a catalyst for shared prosperity and a better future. Through our recruitment, career development and employee-focused programming, we are committed to fostering a welcoming and inclusive work environment where high-performance talent of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can build careers within this exciting and growing industry.

Job Description

Finance Technology is building a dedicated team for the Financial Planning Platform. The Vice President, Fund Finance Technology owns the strategy, roadmap, prioritization, adoption, user experience, and business outcomes for the platform, which helps the organization look forward through forecasting, scenario modeling, strategic planning, performance insights, and decision support. The role works closely with Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), Fund Accounting (FA), Finance leadership, investment teams and other relevant front-office stakeholders, the Corporate Strategy Group (CSG), Enterprise Technology, Enterprise Data Engineering, Reporting & BI, application teams, and delivery partners. CSG leads the broader program and project execution, while this role provides direction, platform ownership, user experience leadership, and long-term roadmap accountability. This is a hands-on role requiring direct engagement with users, planning data, models, formulas, calculations, assumptions, drivers, workflows, integrations, reporting, and platform configuration. The role requires frequent engagement with senior finance and business leaders and is expected to become a trusted partner in shaping how finance users plan, forecast, evaluate scenarios, and make strategic decisions. Success requires strong judgment, curiosity, credibility, and the ability to build trust with users and senior leadership.

REPORTING RELATIONSHIPS

Reports to: Finance Technology leadership; aligned to the Financial Planning Platform capability

Supervises: None initially; provides leadership across internal teams and delivery partners

Primary Functions & Responsibilities

Forward-looking planning, scenarios, and decision support

Own the platform roadmap supporting forecasting, budgeting, scenario modeling, strategic planning, workforce planning, performance management, and management decision support.
Partner with FP&A, Fund Accounting, Finance leadership, and investment teams and other relevant front-office stakeholders to understand business drivers, assumptions, investment activity, fund performance, capital deployment, growth opportunities, risks, and potential outcomes.
Improve the speed, quality, and transparency of forward-looking analysis and help users compare scenarios and understand the impact of changing assumptions.
Translate complex financial and operational questions into intuitive platform solutions, analytics, workflows, and decision-support experiences.

Strategy, roadmap, and outcomes

Own the platform vision, strategy, roadmap, investment priorities, and backlog.
Lead discovery and translate user and business needs into clear problems, intended outcomes, requirements, acceptance criteria, and prioritized work.
Make practical trade-offs across value, user impact, complexity, risk, dependencies, timing, and delivery capacity.
Operate effectively in ambiguous environments by defining problems, establishing priorities, and creating structure where formal processes may not yet exist.
Define success measures and use adoption, user feedback, business value, platform health, and delivery outcomes to guide decisions.
Create and present clear presentation materials covering product strategy, roadmaps, investment priorities, business cases, delivery progress, adoption, and outcomes.
Influence strategic priorities and investment decisions through data-driven recommendations, business cases, roadmap proposals, and executive communication.

Hands-on platform and data leadership

Develop working knowledge of platform data, models, formulas, calculations, assumptions, dimensions, hierarchies, workflows, integrations, reporting structures, and dependencies.
Work directly with users, data, models, configuration, calculations, and reporting outputs to understand issues and identify improvements.
Investigate platform, data, workflow, and reporting issues directly rather than relying exclusively on support teams or partners.
Participate actively in solution design, model reviews, testing, release validation, and platform evaluations.
Work closely with planning modelers and engineers to translate product priorities and user needs into scalable model designs, formulas, workflows, integrations, and user experiences.

AI-enabled workflows and user experience

Identify opportunities to improve projections, scenario analysis, planning workflows, user experience, productivity, insights, and decision-making through AI-enabled capabilities.
Partner with Enterprise Technology, enterprise AI teams, and relevant data teams to evaluate, prioritize, and deliver practical AI-driven solutions.
Help move successful prototypes into governed, reusable, secure, and supportable platform solutions.
Apply user research, journey and workflow analysis, prototyping, feedback, and adoption practices to create simpler, more intuitive experiences.
Drive adoption by helping users embrace new processes, technologies, workflows, and AI-enabled ways of working.

Relationships, trust, and senior leadership engagement

Serve as the primary product partner within Finance Technology for FP&A, Fund Accounting, Finance leadership, investment teams and other relevant front-office stakeholders.
Build trusted, durable relationships by listening closely, understanding user challenges, communicating transparently, and delivering reliably.

jobs.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Design Engineering
jobs.description:
Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

We are seeking a Technical Program Manager to join our GDSCM team, focusing on the Basis of Design (BOD) and Programmatic Design Change Management (PDCM) programs. This role requires deep technical expertise across multiple engineering disciplines and the ability to evaluate complex design changes across 300+ in-flight projects.

As a Technical Program Manager, you will serve as a technical expert evaluating design change requests across electrical, mechanical, civil, structural, architectural, controls, plumbing, fire protection, and thermal systems. You will conduct feasibility analyses, coordinate technical reviews with principal engineers across all disciplines, and manage the end-to-end lifecycle of design changes from initiation through implementation.

You will work closely with Design Engineering, Construction Management, Procurement, Finance, and Product teams to ensure design changes are properly vetted, funded, and executed.

Key job responsibilities

Technical Design Evaluation

Evaluate complex design changes across multiple engineering disciplines including electrical power distribution, mechanical cooling systems, structural loads, civil site work, architectural layouts, controls systems, plumbing infrastructure, and fire protection systems
Analyze technical specifications, construction drawings, equipment datasheets, and system integration requirements to assess design change feasibility and impact
Understand and explain the complexity of data center designs including power distribution from utility to rack level, cooling system architectures, backup power systems, and building infrastructure
Identify technical dependencies and cross-discipline impacts when evaluating proposed design changes
Assess constructability, maintainability, and operational implications of design modifications
Review and validate technical calculations including electrical load calculations, cooling capacity requirements, structural load analysis, and hydraulic calculations

Design Change Management

Manage portfolio of design changes across multiple in-flight projects, ensuring alignment with business priorities and technical requirements
Conduct feasibility analyses and production readiness assessments for proposed design changes, evaluating technical risk, schedule impact, and cost implications
Coordinate technical reviews with principal engineers across mechanical, electrical, structural, civil, architectural, controls, plumbing, and fire protection disciplines
Develop and maintain implementation plans, tracking design change execution from approval through site deployment
Present design change recommendations and cost implications to senior leadership, clearly articulating technical complexity and business impact
Evaluate design improvements and innovations, assessing their applicability across the global portfolio

Cross-Discipline Collaboration

Partner with Electrical Engineers on power distribution design, generator sizing, UPS configurations, switchgear specifications, and high-voltage systems
Collaborate with Mechanical Engineers on cooling system design, HVAC configurations, piping layouts, and thermal management strategies
Work with Structural Engineers on foundation design, seismic requirements, equipment support structures, and building loads
Engage with Civil Engineers on site grading, stormwater management, utility routing, and site infrastructure
Coordinate with Architectural teams on building layouts, space planning, and building envelope design
Interface with Controls Engineers on building management systems, monitoring systems, and automation strategies
Partner with Fire Protection Engineers on fire suppression systems, detection systems, and life safety requirements

Stakeholder Coordination

Partner with Design Management teams to understand project-specific requirements, constraints, and technical challenges
Collaborate with Finance teams on cost validation, funding strategies, and budget tracking for design changes
Work with Construction Management and Procurement teams to assess schedule impacts, supply chain constraints, and constructability
Engage with Product and Solutions teams to evaluate new equipment, emerging technologies, and design approaches
Coordinate with Commissioning teams to ensure design changes support testing and startup requirements

Process Improvement

Identify opportunities to streamline design change workflows and reduce execution timelines while maintaining technical rigor
Develop and maintain technical documentation including standard operating procedures, design standards, technical specifications, and RACI matrices
Contribute to automation initiatives and tooling improvements for design change management
Support integration of cost validation frameworks and bulk funding mechanisms
Drive continuous improvement in technical review processes and design quality standards

Program Execution

Track and report on design change metrics including approval timelines, cost avoidance, implementation status, and technical quality
Maintain design change databases and dashboards for cross-functional visibility
Support BOD release planning and coordination to minimize redesign impacts
Participate in weekly leadership reviews presenting program status, key decisions, and technical recommendations

About The Team

The Global Design Standards and Change Management (GDSCM) organization within Data Center Engineering is responsible for establishing and maintaining design standards across the global data center portfolio. Our team manages three mission-critical programs:

Basis of Design (BOD) Establishes and governs the foundational technical standards for all global data center designs, ensuring consistency and quality across the portfolio.

Programmatic Design Change Management (PDCM) Manages design change requests across 300+ in-flight projects.

360 Equipment Qualification Program (360 EQP) Qualifies equipment and technologies for deployment across the global portfolio, evaluating emerging solutions and driving standardization of critical systems.

Together, these programs deliver capacity across the AMER, APAC, and EMEA regions.

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of technical product or program management experience
7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

Preferred Qualifications

5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Description

Elevate your career with Detroit Defense! Join a dynamic team dedicated to national security through cutting-edge technology. Since 2008, Detroit Defense has led in delivering advanced solutions to the Department of Defense (DoD). Dive into innovation in Systems Engineering, Combat Vehicle Integration, Digital Transformation, Cybersecurity, IT, Data Analytics and Software Development. Your journey to impactful work and rapid growth starts now—Behind the Mission Beyond the Challenge!

Build relationships across customer program offices, operators, and the broader community; engage customers directly where technical credibility advances the opportunity.
Serve as the division's expert on portfolio services and solutions, with emphasis on Navy software and systems engineering; shape offerings to customer mission needs.

Collaborate with functional departments, including the PMO, Engineering, Contracts, and Finance, to develop sound solutions, realistic estimates, and executable staffing plans.
